Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Indian players stride out to the middle. Followed by Deandra Dottin and Hayley Matthews who walk out to open for West Indies Women. Jhulan Goswami to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Now the target is a huge one! Windies have done special things in this World Cup but can this will be a mammoth effort if they do manage to chase it down. The wicket is a decent one but the Indian bowling attack is in form and will back themselves to defend it. Join us for the second essay in a bit.

Smriti Mandhana, one of the stars with the blade for India, is in for a chat. She says that she is really happy by her performance. Mentions it wouldn’t have been possible without Yastika Bhatia's bright start. Adds on to say that the plan was always to rack up runs at a brisk rate in the first Powerplay. Ends by saying, she was under some pressure before the game and would rate this ton a little higher.

Windies were just not at their best right from the start. They were very poor with the new ball and leaked far too many runs. They did manage to get themselves back into the game by taking three quick wickets but gave it away after that. They were so disciplined in the games before but lacked that in this game. They will be very disappointed with how they have performed in this game.

Right from the world go, the Indian batters batted with intent. It was Yastika Bhatia who get them off to a flier. She along with Mandhana added 49 in no time with her being the aggressor. However, once she fell, Windies managed to take two quickly. Just as it seemed like they were getting back into the game, the partnership which took it away from them came. Mandhana and Kaur added 184 with both scoring tons. Mandhana fell but Kaur stayed there and ensured her side would get over the 300-run mark.
A magical performance from two women, Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana has taken India to a score which is well over par. Have to say, they have justified their decision of opting to bat.
Good length, outside off. Rana slaps it to sweeper cover. They only take one. INDIA END THEIR INNINGS AT 317/8.
A yorker now, in the blockhole. SIngh digs it out and gets to the other end for a quick single.
Back of a length, outside off. It is yet another off pace delivery. Meghna Singh tries to cut it away but misses.
A slower length ball, outside off. Meghna Singh leaves it alone.
Meghna Singh is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one falls for India in the death. Back of a length, outside off. Jhulan Goswami looks to cut it away. The ball goes off the outside edge towards short third man. Anisa Mohammed takes the simplest of catches.
Commentary.Howout: c Anisa Mohammed b Deandra Dottin

Commentary.Commentary: Slow full toss, outside off. Jhulan Goswami tries to heave it away but misses it completely.
Back of a length, on off. Jhulan Goswami pulls it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
A length ball, on off. Rana works it to point for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! An outstanding innings of Harmanpreet Kaur comes to an end. The Indian camp with another standing ovation for their second centurian of the innings. It is full and on off. Harmanpreet Kaur tries to paddle it away but the ball takes the outside edge and flies to the right of the keeper. Shemaine Campbelle takes a brilliant catch behind the sticks.
Commentary.Howout: c Shemaine Campbelle b Aaliyah Alleyne

Commentary.Commentary: Length, outside off. Jhulan Goswami pushes it to point for one.
Length ball, on off, blocked out.
Full length, on the pads. Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it through mid-wicket for one.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pooja Vastrakar tries to hunt down her third boundary but holes out instead. Full length, on off. Pooja Vastrakar advances down the track and lobs it to covers. Hayley Matthews takes a dolly. Jhulan Goswami is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Hayley Matthews b Anisa Mohammed

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! What a shot!  A length ball, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar steps down the track and lifts it over the cover region for a boundary.
TWO WIDES! Looped up, full and down leg. Kaur tries to chase it but misses. The keeper makes a half stop and the batters sneak a single as well.
FOUR! Harmanpreet Kaur continues to score freely and manipulates the field really well. Full and on off. Harmanpreet Kaur shuffles across and slog-sweeps it over square leg for a boundary.
A short ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur comes down the track and slaps it to cover.
Short ball, on off. Pooja Vastrakar pulls it to long on for a single. India now cross the 300-run mark.
FOUR! Pooja Vastrakar joins the party now. Back of a length, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar hangs back and cuts it hard past point for a boundary.
Short ball, on off. Harmanpreet Kaur pull it to the leg side but could not get it through the gap.
WIDE! A length ball, wide outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur leaves it alone. Wide called.
FOUR! Up and over! A length ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur hangs back and lofts it over backward point for a boundary, This is incredible hitting.
Length ball, outside off. Kaur look to cut it away but misses.
Full, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar pushes it to cover for one.
Pooja Vastrakar is the new batter.

Full length, outside off. Richa Ghosh shuffles across and throws her blade at it. The ball flies towards mid off and lands safely. Kaur though pushes for two runs. Ghosh agrees but the throw is a good one to the keeper and Ghosh puts in a late dive to get herself inside the crease. The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays later show Richa Ghosh was short of the crease.

This is ONE HUNDRED FOR KAUR! What an incredible knock. A full-length ball, on off. Harmanpreet Kaur prods and works it towards mid on off the inner half. They take a single. Harmanpreet Kaur celebrates it with a huge smile across her face.
Short and wide outside off. Ghosh slahses at it but misses. Harmanpreet Kaur to take the strike. She is on 99.
Tossed up, on off. Kaur pushes it to cover for a single.
Fuller, on leg. Ghosh works it to mid on for a single.
Short and outside off. Richa Ghosh hangs back and tries to cut it away but misses.
WIDE! Looped up, wide outside off. Ghosh tries to chase it but misses. Wide called.
On middle and leg. Kaur works it past mid on for a single.
On a length, outside off. Kaur guides it to backward point for one. There is an overthrow and the batters take one more.
Full length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur leans in, drives it to cover for one. She retains the strike.
Full length, on off, blocked out solidly.
FOUR! Misfield in the deep. Full toss, on off. Harmanpreet Kaur heaves it across the line to deep square leg. The ball bounces in front of the fielder to spin away and go into the rope.
SIX! BANG! Harmanpreet Kaur makes the most of the Free Hit yet again! Full length, on off. Harmanpreet Kaur slog-sweeps it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
NO BALL! A full toss, on off. Richa Ghosh tries to heave across the line. It takes the top edge and goes towards cover. The fielder catches the ball but the square leg umpire signals a no ball.
Length ball, on off. Kaur pushes it to mid off for one.
Full length, outside off. Kaur defends it to cover.
Shakera Selman looks to be in some trouble now. She was ready for her run-up but stop mid-way. Looks like she was feeling dizzy. The physio comes out and takes her out of the field.
On off, blocked out.
Fuller, on off. Kaur flicks it to the leg side for one.
Fuller, on off. Ghosh tries to free her arms and throws her blade at it. The ball lobs off the outer half towards mid off and lands short of the fielder there. They take one.
Tossed up, on the stumps. Ghosh defends it into the deck.
Floated, full and on off. Richa Ghosh blocks it out solidly.
Short ball, on off. Kaur pulls it to dep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball, on off. Kaur taps it to point for one.
WIDE! Back of a length, outside off. This one goes over the batter's head. The square leg umpire signals a wide.
Length ball, outside off. Kaur tries to chase it but misses.
Short ball, on off. Richa Ghosh pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Richa Ghosh comes in to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shakera Selman manages to keep the ball in her arms and Shamilia Connell gets the priced wicket of Smriti Mandhana. Full length, on off. Smriti Mandhana stays inside the crease and hoicks it across the line to deep mid-wicket. Shakera Selman runs to her right. She lost her footing in the deep but was able to keep the catch under control.
Commentary.Howout: c Shakera Selman b Shamilia Connell

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Smriti Mandhana is scoring for fun here. It is short and on off. Smriti Mandhana pulls it to deep square leg and bags a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full length, on off. Kaur sweeps it to square leg for one.

DROPPED! This could have been a brilliant take at covers. Full, on off. Smriti Mandhana drives it aerially towards cover. There was enough height on it and the fielder could only get fingertips on it. They take one.
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! Three in a row! Smriti Mandhana showing no mercy. Fuller, outside off. Smriti Mandhana uses the crease really well by shuffling across and heaves it across the line for another boundary.

FOUR! And again! This is top placement. Full length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana leans in and creams it through the cover region for a boundary. 250 up for India now. It looks like even 250 is on the cards now.
FOUR! There is no stopping Smriti Mandhana at the moment. It is on a length, around off. Smriti Mandhana shuffles across and scoops it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
SIX! BOOM! Harmanpreet Kaur spoils a good over for Shamilia Connell. It is full and outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets underneath and smokes it over the long off fence.
Back of a length, on off. Smriti Mandhana pulls it to deep square leg. It meets the fielder on a bounce. They take a single.
Short ball, on off. Kaur pulls it through square leg for one.
Full toss, on off. Smriti Mandhana heaves it across the line for a single.
Full, outside off. Kaur looks to scoop it away, but the ball dies off the inner half. The batters take a quick single.
Play and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Kaur shuffles across, hangs her blade out only to get beaten on the outside edge.
End of Powerplay 2! Now, 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring until the end of the innings.
Fuller, on off. Kaur gets low and sweeps it through square leg for one.
Length, outside off. Mandhana guides it to short third man for a quick single.
Short and on off. Kaur pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to deep point for one.

FOUR! Short and punished! Smriti Mandhana gets her TON! This is an incredible knock. Also, when her side needed it the most. All the players in the Indian dugout are on their feet, as Smriti Mandhana soaks herself with the appreciation from the fans as well as her team-mates. A short ball, on off. Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Fuller, on the stumps. Smriti Mandhana defends it out solidly.
Full, on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover for one.

A length ball, on the pads, some extra bounce as well. Smriti Mandhana tries to work it across the line but misses. She gets pinged on her thigh pad. Shamilia Connell appeals but the umpire is unmoved. It looks pretty close to naked eye. Shamilia Connell and the keeper are interested but they do not take the review.
A sharp bouncer, on the bodyline. Smriti Mandhana picks it up late. She ducks under it at the very last moment.
A length ball, outside off. Kaur punches it aerially past the point fielder for one run.
Back of a length, on off. Smriti Mandhana pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, on the pads. Kaur flicks it to mid-wicket for one.

DROPPED! A tough chance though. Full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana gets low and slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep charges towards the ball, puts in a forward dive but is unable to gather it safely. Smriti Mandhana takes a couple of runs and moves to 96.
Nervous 90s! Full, on off, blocked out.
Short, outside off. Smriti Mandhana guides it to short third man.
On off, blocked back to the bowler.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana wants to race away to her ton. She is just 6 runs short now. Tossed up, angled down leg. Smriti Mandhana swivels and glances it past short fine leg to find the boundary.
On the pads, Kaur clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Full, outside off. Mandhana pushes it to cover.
Kaur works it to mid on for a single. The pair making sure to keep the runs ticking. The pair continues to hurt West Indies.
Full length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur slashes it through point for two.
A length ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur chips it past point. It goes through the gap and they take two.
A length ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana guides it to third man for one.
SIX! BANG! Smriti Mandhana moves to 89. Full length, on middle. Smriti Mandhana clears her front leg and tonks it over the long on fence for a maximum. India Women surely eyeing 300 at the moment.
Full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to cover for a single.
Full, on the pads. Kaur clips it to mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Streaky! Short ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur throws her blade at it. The ball flies off the outside edge. It even evades the effort of the short third man fielder and races away to the fence.
Full, outside off. Mandhana guides it to deep point for one more.
Full and on off. Kaur sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Harmanpreet Kaur comes down the track to a full delivery and hoicks it across the line towards deep mid-wicket for two runs. Could not make the most of the Free Hit.
NO BALL! Full length, on off. Smriti Mandhana works it towards wide of long off. The batters take a single. The umpire signals a no ball, as the bowler oversteps.
Full length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur tries to chase it but misses. Three dots in a row to a good over for Aaliyah Alleyne.
On off, blocked out.

Direct hit and Smriti Mandhana was out of here! This is how close it gets. Fuller, on middle and leg. Kaur tucks it to mid-wicket. Smriti Mandhana is out of her crease looking for a single before being sent back. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end and misses the stumps by a whisker.

In the air but safe! Full length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana throws her blade at it. The ball flies off the toe end behind mid off. The fielder comes running in from the deep but could not get there in time.
Length ball, on off. Mandhana pushes it to cover.
Full length, outside off. Kaur pushes it to cover and takes off to the other end. Stafanie Taylor fails to collect it. The batters take an easy single.
Length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out watchfully.
Outside off, Kaur works it to point for a single.
Full, on middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur drags her sweep towards square leg.
Full, on off. Kaur pushes it to point.
Touch short, on the body. Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it to square leg for one.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana is on fire! Full length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana comes down the track, plays inside out over covers and finds a boundary.

FOUR! What a shot! FIFTY FOR KAUR! This is incredible hitting. Full-length ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets on one knee and lofts it over mid off to bag a boundary. She makes the most of the Free Hit. Also this stand exceeds the 100-run mark!

NO BALL! Slower ball, full and on off. Harmanpreet Kaur defends it into the deck on the front foot. But Shakera Selman fails to land any part of her front foot behind the crease and the umpire signals a no ball. Free Hit coming up!
Length, on the fifth stump line. Kaur blocks it out solidly.
Back of a length, outside off, nips away a shade off the deck. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and cuts it through point for one.
Length ball, on off. Smriti Mandhana defends it out to the off side.
SIX! ALL THE WAY! Smriti Mandhana freeing her arms now! This is a glorious shot. Full length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana smokes it over the long off fence for a maximum with a good arm swing.
Full length, around off. Kaur pushes it to cover with soft hands for a single.
Looped up, full and on leg. Smriti Mandhana tries to flick it away but misses. The ball hits her pad, Taylor appeals but the umpire is unmoved. 7 runs off the over. A good one for India.
Short ball, on off. Kaur pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Swep away! It is full, on off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets low and on top of the bounce. She sweeps it powerfully though square leg to find a boundary. Harmanpreet Kaur at her best!
Full length, on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to sweeper cover for one.
Flatter, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur hangs back and cuts it throughpoint for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur tries to defend it out but misses.
Length ball, on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover. She wants a single but Kaur denies it. Just two from the over then. West Indies Women have started well after the drinks break.
On a length, around middle and leg. Kaur clips it through square leg for one.
Full length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur leans in to defend it to cover. The batters were looking for a single but Shakera Selman is quick to reach the ball.
Length ball, on the stumps. Harmanpreet Kaur defends it out watchfully with a straight bat.
Full length, on the pads. Smriti Mandhana flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Full length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana defends it to cover.

DRINKS! After losing three wickets in quick succession. India looked to be in a spot of bother. Although the stand between Mandhana-Kaur has got them to safer shores. West Indies have been unable to keep this pair quiet. They know a wicket or two can get them back in the contest. If India keeps batting in the same manner, they can score 300 plus. An interesting passage of play awaits.
On off. Kaur defends it out solidly to see off the over.
Full, on leg. Smriti Mandhana tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and steers it down to third man for a brace.
WIDE! Looped up, wide outside off, but it lands outside the tramline. Mandhana has nothing to offer. Wide called by the umpire.
Short and on off. Kaur pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, around off, angling across. Harmanpreet Kaur defends it out on the front foot.
A dot to start with! Floated, full, on middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur goes back and blocks it into the deck.
Change. Stafanie Taylor comes into the attack now.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur punches it through point for one. 5 runs off it. This stand keeps growing.
Third dot of the over! A length ball, on the stumps. Harmanpreet Kaur defends it solidly.
Full length, on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to cover for a single.
On a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana guides it towards point.
Full length, on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to mid off.
WIDE! Length, sliding down leg. Smriti Mandhana decides to flirt with it but does not get any blade on it. Wide called though.
150 UP FOR INDIA! A length ball, on the pads. Smriti Mandhana flicks it to deep square leg for a brace.
Full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana leans in and drives it into covers for one. A good over for India.
Full and on the stumps. Mandhana blocks it back to bowler.
On off, blocked out.
Fuller and on leg. Kaur tucks it to mid-wicket and makes it to the other end in no time. This is really good running.
Full, on middle and leg. Mandhana clips it to mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Good start to the over for India Women. Smriti Mandhana is looking good now. Length ball, just outside off. Smriti Mandhana waits for it, opens the face of the blade and steers it past point for one.
Length, around off. Smriti Mandhana steers it towards third man for one. She retains the strike.

FOUR! Smriti Mandhana gets her second half ton of the tournament. Great timing on this one. But she knows her job is only half done. Low full toss, on middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana flicks it through mid-wicket. She gets it through the gap and bags a boundary.
Full length, on off. Kaur pushes it to cover for a single.
A slower short ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur shuffles across to pull it to mid-wicket from outside off. She waits a long time because of no pace on offer.
A length ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana guides it down to third man for a single.
Fuller, on off. Smriti Mandhana defends it out solidly.

FOUR! Up and over! Harmanpreet Kaur bags another boundary in this over. This stand it turing out to be a good one for India. It is worth 58 runs now. Fuller, on off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets low and tries to sweep it away. It take the top-edge and flies over short fine leg. The fielder there back pedals but is unable to get under the ball. The ball races away to the boundary.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Kaur works it towards mid on.
Around off, blocked out watchfully.
FOUR! Harmanpreet Kaur is on a roll. Tossed up, full and down leg. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it fine on the leg side and bags a boundary.
On a length, on off. Smriti Mandhana punches it to point for a quick single.
Short and outside off. Smriti Mandhana cuts it to point. Deandra Dottin misfields and the batters take two comfortably.
A full toss on off, Kaur drives but to covers.
Shorter and angling into the body, Smriti Mandhana looks to pull but misses. It hits the pad and lobs on the leg side for one. No signal so there might eb an inside edge.
Two dots in a row! That is rare. On off, this is played to point.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Fuller and outside off again, Harmanpreet Kaur looks to drive, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Just wide! Outside off, Smriti Mandhana pushes at it away from the body, it goes uppishly but wide of point for one.
A run at least on every ball in this over! Shorter and on the body, Mandhana pulls it through square leg for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Nicely played! The paddle scoop comes out. It is hit through backward square leg for two.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Comes down the track and then works it through square leg for one.
Edgy run! Tossed up on middle, this lands and turns away. Goes off the outside edge as Mandhana tries to defend. Down to third man for one.
The last two balls spoils the over! Short and on the body, SM looks to pull, it goes off the top edge towards fine leg for one.
FOUR! Clipped away! That is easy pickings! Full and on the pads, this is worked through square leg and this one races away to the fence.
Good length and around off, Smriti Mandhana guides it to point.
Slightly shorter and on off, Mandhana plays it back to the bowler.
Outside off, this is played through covers for one.
Fuller and on off, Kaur plays a check-drive, uppish for a bit but lands well short of covers.
A single to end! Mid on has been pushed back and that is exactly where Kaur takes one by easing it.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Fuller and on middle, Kaur flicks it to mid-wicket.
Yet another easy run! Fuller and on off, Mandhana strokes it down to long on for one.
On middle, Kaur works it to mid on for one more.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Close again! Kaur just had to get bat on ball there. She yet again shuffles across, this is on middle, she keeps it out.
Two more! Runs coming easily for the two out there now! A full toss on middle, this is pulled through square leg for a couple.
Back of a length and on off, Kaur pushes it to covers.
She had to hit that! Kaur shuffles across, this is full and on middle, Kaur works it through square leg for two.
Shorter and on middle, Mandhana pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
Length and on middle, defended.
Fuller and outside off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it through covers for one. 100 up India and this is another good partnership building for the Indians.
Well bowled! Tosses it up and lands it on middle, kept out.
Shorter now and on middle, Kaur pulls it through square leg for one.
FOUR! Hit hard and a boundary! Kaur steps out and makes it into a half volley. This is powered down the ground, past mid off for a boundary.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked to mid on.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Solid again! Length and on off, Kaur blocks.
Shorter and on off, Kaur pushes it to covers.
Outside off, Smriti Mandhana guides it down to third man for one.
Outside off, Kaur pushes it through covers for one.
On the pads, this is nudged around the corner for one.
Back of a length and on off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it to covers.
A dot to end! On middle, fuller, this is pushed to mid on.
FOUR! Cut away! Short and asking to be hit. Harmanpreet Kaur goes back and cuts it through point. This one races away to the fence.
Floats it up on off, blocked.
Brilliant from Dottin! Shorter and outside off, Kaur cuts, Dottin at point dives to her right and stops. She might have already saved 10 runs for her side.
On middle, defended.
Well fielded! Floated up on off, Mandhana drives it towards cover. The fielder dives and gbets a hand to it. She saves two at least. A single though can't be prevented.
Two more! On off, this is pushed nicely, wide of the fielder at sweeper cover for two.
On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Another one on the shorter side, this time she hits it through point, the fielder was pushed back and hence, only one.
Kaur misses out yet again! Shorter and outside off, Kaur cuts but can't beat point.
Another one on the stumps, Kaur defends it out nicely.
Good length and on off, defended.
On middle, blocked.
On middle, Kaur nudges it on the leg side and gets to the other end.
Floats it up on off, defended.
On middle, Kaur works it to mid-wicket.
Kaur misses out! Short and outside off, that was asking to be hit. Kaur cuts but to point.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shorter and on off, Kaur pushes it to covers. Just the single from the over. Better from Shamilia Connell!
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards deep square leg. There is protection in the deep so only one.
Back of a length and on off, this is guided to point.
Fuller and on off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it to mid off.
On middle, Smriti Mandhana stays back and keeps it out.
Shorter and on off, Mandhana pushes it to point.
Tossed up on off, Kaur pushes it to covers. A dot to end a successful over for Windies.
Harmanpreet Kaur is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! What a grab that is! Outstanding. Hayley Matthews, you beauty, she can do no wrong at the moment. It was Deandra Dottin in Windies' last game and now Matthews. Sharma goes and India are three down now. Windies well and truly back into this one. Anisa Mohammed does not take time to make an impact. This is tossed up on off, Sharma looks to play the sweep but there is extra bounce, it goes off the top edge and Hayley Matthews at first slip dives to her right, sticks one hand up and takes a beauty.
Commentary.Howout: c Hayley Matthews b Anisa Mohammed

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on off, defended.
Outside off, Mandhana this time pushes it through covers for one.
On off, this one turns away a touch. It is guided to point.
Was that a chance? Shorter and outside off, it lands and turns away. Mandhana looks to cut but is beaten. Not sure about the edge, replays are not conclusive.
On middle, defended.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! This is probably going to be Shakera Selman's last over in this spell. She has not bowled well since being warned. Short and outside off now, Sharma stands tall and slaps it through covers. This one races away to the fence.
Goes back to bowling it on a length and around off, Sharma guides it to point.
FOUR! That is a lovely shot! It is right in the zone for Sharma. Full and on middle, it is heaved over mid-wicket. A welcome boundary as the runs had dried up a touch.
Length again and on off, Sharma pushes it to covers.
Good length and on off, defended.
Just the one from the over then! On the pads, Deepti works it down to fine leg for one.
Another dot! On middle, kept out.
SOft leading edge! On middle, Sharma initially looks to flick but this one holds its line. It is a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
Slightly fuller this time, Sharma pushes it to mid off.
Well bowled! Lands it on off, gets extra bounce. Hits the splice of the bat as Sharma looks to defend.
Tossed up on off, defended.
A single from the Free Hit! Selman goes full and on off, Sharma tries to go over long on but does not connect that well. The fielder there takes the catch. Only one.

On off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards cover for one. No ball signaled now as Shakera Selman has overstepped. That warning might be playing on her mind as he has not bowled well after that. Free Hit coming up.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, left alone.
This one is very short, it comes slow off the surface. It is pulled down to fine leg for one. A warning too for Shakera Selman for running onto the danger area.
A slower one and on the fuller side, Deepti Sharma pushes it to covers.
Another one on a length and around off, Sharma pushes it to covers again.
Shorter and on off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it through covers for one.
Good length and on middle, defended.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring until the end of 40th over.

That is a really good delivery! Two runs in the end for Sharma but she was not comfortable playing it. It lands on middle and then spins away. Sharma looks to block, it goes off the outside edge down to third man. Sharma hesitates before taking off for the second but goes for it. The throw is to the keeper but Sharma makes it in with the dive.
Sharma is off the mark with two! Outside off, fuller, it is driven through covers for a couple.
Tossed up on off, Sharma blocks.
Deepti Sharma comes in at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! Hayley Matthews gets rid of the Indian captain, Mithali Raj and Windies have two wickets in quick time. Another soft dismissal. This lands on off and turns back in. Slightly fuller. Raj looks to flick but since it comes slow off the surface, she is early into the shot. It goes uppishly and straight to mid-wicket where it is taken by Shamilia Connell.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamilia Connell b Hayley Matthews

Commentary.Commentary: Well bowled again! Fires it on off, Raj pushes it to covers.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
Yes, so once again, just the boundary from the over. Fuller and on off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it to mid off.
Fuller and on off, Mandhana looks to drive, this one comes back in, it goes off the inner half to mid on. Can the over be ended well?

FOUR! That is a poor delivery and it is put away! That has been the problem for the Windies, there has been a poor ball in almost every over. Short and down the leg side. Mandhana pulls it behind square and it races away.
Another one on the fuller side, swings back in. It seems to be holding in the surface. Mandhana pushes it to mid off.
Good delivery! A slower one and on off, tails back in a little. It is worked to mid-wicket.
That was there to be hit and Smriti Mandhana knows that! She practices the pull shot after defending it. Shorter and on off, it is played to mid off.
She does! So five dots after going for a boundary on the very first ball.The last one is tossed up and it lands on off, blocked.
Quicker and on off, Raj blocks. Can Hayley Matthews end the over well now?
A touch fuller again, Mithali Raj plays the drive again but to covers this time.
Flatter and on off, Raj plays it out on the off side.
Better! Drags her length back and bowls it on off, Raj pushes it to covers.
FOUR! That is a gift for Raj! Full and outside off, she leans into it and strokes it through covers for a boundary. Poor from Hayley Matthews that was right in the slot.
That is a really good first over from Shakera Selman! Length and on off to end. Smriti Mandhana plays it back to the bowler.
Raj is off the mark and the 50 is up for India! Outside off, Raj guides it down to third man for one.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Mithali Raj comes in at number 3. Although this time the opening stand has put up a solid foundation. Can Mithali Raj make the most of it?

OUT! TAKEN! The free-flowing innings of Yastika Bhatia has been cut short and the opening stand is broken one run short of fifty! That is a soft dismissal. Yastika Bhatia will be a touch disappointed there. This is a length ball on middle, it holds in the surface a touch. Bhatia pushes at it with hard hands, ends up chipping it straight back to the bowler who takes it. Welcome wicket for West Indies. That though was a good little innings from Bhatia, she would have loved to go on for longer but she has got India off to a very good start. Windies though can now stem the run flow.
The length was fine but the line is a little too straight. Yastika Bhatia works it through square leg for two.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off. This is probably the right length to Bhatia.
Shakera Selman comes into the attack now. Change from both ends then.
6 from the over then! Flatter and on middle, Smriti Mandhana defends it.
Turn again! Shorter this time and on off, Mandhana guides it to point.
FOUR! Up and over! Smriti Mandhana uses her feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over covers for a boundary, That is a lovely shot. Trademark Mandhana.
Slower through the air and outside off, Mandhana lets it be.
Two more! Edgy runs. India won't care! Another one floated outside off, Smriti Mandhana looks to drive, this lands and turns away. It goes off the outside edge down to third man for two.
Turn for Hayley Matthews straightaway! This is tossed up, nice and slow outside off. Smriti Mandhana looks to drive but is beaten.
Change. Time for some spin now. Hayley Matthews comes into the attack now. Can she change the fortunes for West Indies Women?
A single to end another big over for India! Outside off, Smriti Mandhana guides it down to third man for one.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana now joins the party! Full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana opens the face of the bat and strokes it through covers and this one races away to the fence.
Another run! On middle, Bhatia works it through square leg for one. Really good batting.

FOUR! This is poor bowling! This is short and on middle, Yastika Bhatia is feeding on such balls. She pulls it over square leg for a boundary. Consecutive ones and the little pressure that was built has been released.

FOUR! Put away! Yastika Bhatia has been fearless so far and it is coming off. Shorter and on middle, she heaves this across the line and through mid-wicket for a boundary. She is dealing in boundaries.
Good length and on off, Bhatia plays it to covers.
WIDE! Way too wide outside off, Yastika Bhatia slashes but misses.

Just over! The fielder should have put in a better effort there. Fuller and on off, Bhatia looks to go over mid off. Does not time it that well. The fielder there moves back and then leaps but it goes just over. She was slow in moving back there.
On off, this is pushed to covers.

Another brilliant effort from Dottin! Wow! She has put on a show in the first few overs. Outside off, fuller, this is lofted over covers. Dottin runs after it from point and right at the end, dives and pushes it back in. Saves a run for her side.
That is brilliant from Deandra Dottin again. This is on off, shorter, this is pushed towards point. Dottin moves to her left, dives and saves a run.
Uppish but well short! On off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it on the up but to covers. Another dot.
Length and on off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it to covers.

That is magical from Dottin again. It is better if you do not run when you hit it to her and also do not hit it up in the air near her. This one is all along the ground, Yastika Bhatia guides this delivery which is outside off towards Dottin at point. She dives to her right and stops it. Yastika Bhatia was off for a run but seeing the effort had to get back. Does make it back in.
BEATEN! Loose stroke! Behind a driving length and outside off, Bhatia goes after it away from the body but is beaten.
Well fielded! Goes fuller, Smriti Mandhana shows the full face face of the bat and strokes it to the right of mid off. Stafanie Taylor dives and saves at least two for her side.
Three dots! On off, Smriti Mandhana blocks it out.
Good stuff! Another one on a length and on middle, blocked.
Good length and around off, Smriti Mandhana pushes it to covers.
Good shot but for no runs! Fuller and on off, Yastika Bhatia strokes it on the up but to covers. A dot to end but the damage was done earlier one.
Two more! Off the front foot this time. Fuller and on off, Bhatia strokes it through covers for two.

FOUR! Put away again! The around the wicket angle is probably playing into Yastika Bhatia's hands! Short again and on the body, Bhatia pulls it behind square this time on the leg side for her 4th boundary. India off to a flier.

FOUR! Up and over again! Third boundary for Yastika Bhatia and the second over still has three balls to go. Short again and on imddle, Bhatia loves such deliveries, she goes back and pulls it hard over the mid-wicket fielder for another boundary.
WIDE! Some movement again into the batter but the line is down the leg side. Bhatia looks to flick but misses.

FOUR! Cracked away! What a shot that is. The key was she picked the length early. Bhatia on the charge. Slightly shorter and on middle, Bhatia rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Second boundary for her.
Some inward movement for Henry! She starts from around the wicket, begins it from outside off and shapes it back in. This is guided to point.
Chinelle Henry to bowl from the other end.
A dot to end but a good first over for India! Length and on middle, blocked.
A single now! On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.

FOUR! Top edge and a boundary! Aggressive stroke from Yastika Bhatia! Just to remind you, India were quite defensive with their approach in the last game. Seems like it is a changed one here. This is not a bad ball, it is shortish and around off, Bhatia looks to pull, it goes off the top edge and down to the third man fence.
On middle, Bhatia flicks but to mid-wicket.
Well bowled! Good length and on off, Bhatia defends. No swing initially for Connell.
Two now! Smriti Mandhana growing nicely. It is short and outside off. Smriti Mandhana cuts it late towards point. Deandra Dottin misfields and the batters take two.

Done and dusted with the anthems and now it is time for the action to begin! The Windies players make their way out to the middle and they are followed by Smriti Mandhana and Yastika Bhatia. Stafanie Taylor has the first new ball in hand, she now gives it to Shamilia Connell who will start things off. Here we go...
The players make their way out for the national anthems! It is India who will sing their first and then it will be the Windies' turn.

West Indies Women (Unchanged playing XI) - Deandra Dottin, Hayley Matthews, Kycia Knight, Stafanie Taylor (C), Shemaine Campbelle (WK), Chedean Nation, Chinelle Henry, Aaliyah Alleyne, Anisa Mohammed, Shakera Selman, Shamilia Connell.

India Women (Unchanged playing XI) - Yastika Bhatia, Smriti Mandhana, Deepti Sharma, Mithali Raj (C), Harmanpreet Kaur, Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana, Pooja Vastrakar, Jhulan Goswami, Meghna Singh, Rajeshwari Gayakwad.

Stafanie Taylor says they would have batted first too. Adds they are feeling good but there is still a long way to go. Mentions they are West Indians and they will always have that flare and that is how they like it. Ends by informing they are playing the same team.

Mithali Raj says it is the same strip which was used in their last game and it slows down as the game goes on. Adds a win is important if they want to make it into the top 4. Mentions they will be looking to put up a good total. States they are looking forward to this game, the batting has not clicked so far but she hopes it does here. Informs they are unchanged.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor India. THEY WILL BAT!

India on the other hand, after starting their campaign in style were thumped by the host in their second. They just haven’t been at their best so far. Even in the victory against Pakistan, one wouldn’t say it was the best cricket they have played. They’ll need to bring their A-game to the fore here against an in-form West Indies side. Can they hand the Windies their first loss? We will find out.

If there’s one team which has punched above its weight so far then it has to be the Windies. They have surprised many by the way they have played. Windies have managed to beat the Kiwis and England and now face another stern test against the Indians. Can they win three in a row now?
... MATCHDAY ...
